title: hybrid.rs process_announce still derives gradient destination as fe80::+IID (legacy)
description: Found during v9ke review pass 2 (destination = AddrForKey sweep). rust/lichen-node/src/hybrid.rs:474-498 HybridRouter::process_announce builds the gradient destination as link-local fe80:: + originator_iid and stores it with GradientSource::Announce — the rejected LICHEN-native correlation, inconsistent with lichen-node/src/announce.rs which now (v9ke) stores the upstream AddrForKey(originator pubkey) full address. No production caller found (only its own unit test process_announce_installs_gradient at hybrid.rs:903); other HybridRouter writers (on_rrep_received, learn_from_data, forward-path entries) use full packet addresses, so no split-brain today, but any future caller wiring announces through HybridRouter would reintroduce the wrong derivation. Fix: change the parameter to the originator pubkey ([u8;32]) and derive via lichen_core::addr::ygg_addr_from_pubkey (mirroring announce.rs), or delete the unused method; update the test to match. Verify cargo test -p lichen-node hybrid.
close_reason: DONE (worker4, commit fd6e39cc7e). HybridRouter::process_announce (rust/lichen-node/src/hybrid.rs) now takes originator_pubkey [u8;32] and derives the gradient destination via lichen_core::addr::ygg_addr_from_pubkey — upstream AddrForKey, mirroring AnnounceProcessor::process (announce.rs:222) — replacing the rejected fe80::+IID derivation. No production callers existed (grep: only its own unit test; rpl_stack/receive.rs calls the unrelated AnnounceProcessor::process), so the API-signature change is safe. Test process_announce_installs_gradient now pins the external upstream yggdrasil-go anchor (pubkey bdbacfd8...6efb -> 0200848a604fbb7e438465db8db66895, test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json upstream_addr_for_key) as independent oracle, not the impl under test. Side benefit confirmed by reviewer: old fe80:: key was never consultable by route() (LinkLocal short-circuits before the table); new 0200::/8 key classifies MeshLocal and is actually looked up. Verify: cargo test -p lichen-node --features std hybrid 25/25 green; cargo fmt clean on hybrid.rs; full-lib (341 pass/18 fail) and clippy duplicated-attribute failures confirmed PRE-EXISTING via git-stash baseline (identical without my change; tracked by nnmc/5217). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3: correctness PASS, edge-cases PASS, security 1 P3 finding (pub route-mutating API lacked a documented authentication precondition — fixed in-place pre-commit with a # Security doc section requiring a signature-verified, freshness-checked announce; repo precedent for pre-commit review fixes). No new beads needed.
